text:
mina_marketing: Quick heads-up  I uploaded a new draft of the product launch blog for Dedicated (link: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/dedicated-launch-v2.md). Trying to get approvals and lock copy today so we can schedule publish + webinar invites.

sam_product: Got it, reading. First pass: can we tighten the opening paragraph? It currently tries to do too much. Suggest: 'Redwood Dedicated provides predictable latency and cost for production LLM workloads.'

mina_marketing: Love that — edited in.

jordan_design: Small ask: hero screenshot still shows beta badge. Can we remove it? Also updated the performance chart to use the new palette. Uploaded in assets.

lee_growth: For outreach I've drafted two subject lines and three preview texts. Preference for subject: 'Run LLMs at predictable cost with Redwood Dedicated'. Preview: 'Reserve capacity, SLAs, and predictable per-token economics.'

alex_sales: Sales routing note: CTA 'Request a Dedicated trial' should hit /sales/leads?source=blog_launch_dedicated and include utm params. Also add a hidden field on the lead form 'lead_tier=dedicated_interest'. That way we can auto-prioritize.

mina_marketing: added the CTA and UTM to the doc: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=cta_trial`. Alex — can you confirm the webhook handling these params?

alex_sales: Confirmed. Webhook will accept utm_* params and populate SFDC fields accordingly. We'll set up a rule to mark lead_tier from hidden field.

sam_product: Benchmarks check: we should avoid absolute statements. Change '2x throughput' -> '~2x typical throughput' and add parenthetical 'under sustained batching=4, seq=1024'. Also update p99 number: publish p50=26ms, p99=220ms on A100 dedicated pool.

mina_marketing: updated numbers and added the parenthetical. Also put a short methodology blurb in the appendix for transparency.

jordan_design: Replaced hero, adjusted mobile spacing.

release-bot: note: release calendar conflict detected on 2024-06-27. There is already an internal product update scheduled that day. Recommend shifting the public blog to 2024-06-28 or coordinating communication windows.

mina_marketing: thanks release-bot. Let's move public publish to 06-28. Webinar still on 06-29?

lee_growth: 06-29 works for webinar invites. I'll prepare the invite list and ad copy.

alex_sales: Also want to ensure the demo request routes to the right AE queue for enterprise leads (Account Execs: East/West). I'll add mapping rules after we see initial lead geo.

mina_marketing: Legal sign-off required on benchmark claims and customer quote usage. @sam_product can you loop Legal?

sam_product: looping Legal now. Will update thread when they approve.

mina_marketing: checklist for final push: copy locked, hero updated, p50/p99 + methodology in appendix, CTA + UTM in place, webhook & hidden field confirmed, release date set to 2024-06-28, webinar invite for 06-29, legal sign-off. Planning to ship to production at 10:00 PT on publish day once Legal confirms.

alex_sales: Great. Also let's include a short form question 'Are you evaluating dedicated capacity?' to qualify leads pre-demo.

mina_marketing: will add to the form. Thanks team :rocket:
